description: Two roped mountaineers in padded down suits, one red and one blue, climb a steep snowy rock ridge toward a dark summit under a stormy sky. They carry an ice axe and wear crampons and harnesses. The painting fills the frame edge to edge in loose oil brushwork. I see no text, border, frame, blood or nudity.
reason: The picture shows two mountaineers climbing a snowy ridge, but the card is the 1954 Geneva Accords on Indochina, a diplomatic settlement between France and the Viet Minh. Nothing in the image refers to a treaty, negotiators, Vietnam or Indochina; it needs a painting of the conference or its people.
